# Kevin Song

> Kevin Song is a Vanderbilt University computer science student with a business minor and an Ingram Scholar. His work connects software engineering, applied AI, product development, community initiatives, and bilingual music.

This is a supplementary guide to Kevin’s public portfolio. The linked pages contain the full descriptions, roles, source links, and project limitations.

## Profile and chapters

- [Home](https://kevinsong.dev/): Kevin Song’s portfolio and introduction.
- [About Kevin Song](https://kevinsong.dev/about/): Vanderbilt, the Ingram Scholarship, and music in English and Chinese as KSONG (宋凯文).
- [Engineering](https://kevinsong.dev/engineering/): Software and AI projects; experience at Elysian, Ivy Journey, NIST, and Handshake MOVE. Elysian work is described at a high level.
- [Impact](https://kevinsong.dev/impact/): DevelopIT co-founder, Ingram-funded MNPS / Save The Music initiative, and Vanderbilt Recording Studio leadership.

## Project case studies

- [SongSearch](https://kevinsong.dev/work/songsearch/): Music analysis using a React/TypeScript interface, Firebase, and cloud inference.
- [SignLect](https://kevinsong.dev/work/signlect/): ASL sign detection with a custom YOLO model on Raspberry Pi. This is sign recognition, not general ASL translation; the repository is private.
- [Canary.ai](https://kevinsong.dev/work/canary-ai/): A team-built emergency-information app using React Native, Bun, Supabase, and location-aware retrieval.
- [AIHealth](https://kevinsong.dev/work/aihealth/): An exploratory VandyHacks fitness and meal-planning chatbot prototype, with links to Devpost and the public repository.
